current.text: He is almost certain to start. Josh's projected Dallas starting five is Kyrie Irving, Max Christie, Cooper Flagg, P.J. Washington and Morez Johnson Jr.
Dusty May, the new Dallas head coach, has said Christie will have a breakout year.

Experts see no real upside for him this season, especially with Kyrie Irving back. Cooper Flagg is the first priority on offense and Kyrie is second, and Kyrie's shots come mostly from players other than Flagg.
Josh is not interested in Christie outside 18 or 20 team leagues.
Dallas has a 4-4-4 schedule in the fantasy playoffs, probably the best in the league, but also a league-high 16 back-to-backs. Dallas has a two-game week in the matchup starting March 1.

durable.text: He shot 40% from three and about 90% on free throws.
He takes under two free throws a game, so his high FT% moves a team's FT% only a little.
He is a pure scorer with good efficiency, but he struggles to scale up his scoring.
His assists, steals and blocks are poor. He rarely passes, does not generate steals and does not crash the glass.
He is not a big self-creator.

note: Both sites value Christie at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 252, ESPN rank 178), and Josh only wants him in 18 or 20 team leagues. Do not draft him in our 12 team auction. He is a likely starter whose value is about 2.2 threes and 88% FT on low volume, with below-average FG%, steals, assists and rebounds, so he is at most a streaming option for threes. Early in the season, check whether his shot volume holds with Kyrie Irving back. Dallas's 4-4-4 playoff schedule makes him a possible late-season streamer.
